text: The total in Operating Model!C35 comes out about 38,500 too low, because the 38,500 sitting on the line at C33 was entered in a form the file treats as text instead of a number, so the total leaves it out. Nothing looks broken on screen — the figure simply reads smaller than the lines it is meant to add up. If you report that total or make decisions from it, you are working from an amount that is short by 38,500.
system: You explain spreadsheet defects to finance and operations people who are not Excel experts. You never compute or invent numbers: every figure you mention must already appear in the evidence you were given. You never claim something is wrong that the evidence does not state. Write plainly, in the second person, with no jargon and no exclamation marks.
